name: unreal-engine
description: Typed, safety-reviewed Unreal Editor operations through the running editor's Remote Control (connection inspect with server-reported listener verification, typed object describe, typed property reads, allowlisted property writes with the mandatory five-part reversibility chain, individually allowlisted function invocation) — a loopback-only HTTP/WS connector that attaches to an externally owned editor and never spawns or terminates anything.

rcEndpoint.description: Loopback Remote Control endpoint override as host:httpPort:wsPort (loopback literal hosts only; discovered defaults 127.0.0.1:30010/30020 when unset)

rcPassphrase.description: Remote Control transport-compatibility token (route compatibility only — never authentication; the documented public default is used when unset)

provenance.reviewRef: M4 capability contracts (TL-authored, maintainer-accepted; WP-5 connector integration TL-reviewed under strict TDD)
